sources.title: University of Tokyo General Library official special rare-books classification and scope boundary
sources.provider: The University of Tokyo Library System, General Library
sources.quality_notes: Library's official rare-book rule specifies A00/A05 (Japanese) and A100/A150 (Western) prefix categories, with OPAC shelf locations also noted; G23:194 is not one of listed rare prefixes. This does not establish exact G23:194 item placement, current access rights or scanned page existence. Do not invoke privileged rare item reproduction process by prefix inference.

sources.title: University of Tokyo General Library official stored Wa-Kan old-book access and copying conditions
sources.provider: The University of Tokyo Library System, General Library
sources.quality_notes: Official stored Wa-Kan old-books service indicates general visitors may request in-library reading/copying, no open-stack admission or lending for general public, staff retrieval through counter, independent public photocopier not allowed, contractor copying may be requested for eligible condition, and photographing normally prohibited with limited staff-approved up to ten cuts/day. Whether G23:194 physical item is stored under this category requires exact OPAC shelf-location bridge; nothing submitted or obtained.
